title: Bunny Dolls and Disturbing Allegations: Max Miller’s Strange CNN Interview
summary: In a 23-minute appearance with the anchor Jake Tapper, the Ohio Republican made an unusual effort to rebut a multitude of allegations that have threatened his re-election bid.
